title: Harbison Protection Contracts: Schedule of Coverage Terms and Covered Components
content:
The Harbison Protection Contracts line is sold and issued in six tiers. This schedule sets, for each tier, how long covered labor and covered parts are paid and which components a claim may name.

**Coverage terms.** Labor coverage years are counted from the contract's coverage start; covered labor is paid only within them, and the labor coverage years are also the contract term. Parts coverage years are counted from the coverage start; covered parts are paid within them only once no manufacturer parts warranty applies. A parts figure of 0 means the tier never pays a part.

| Tier | Labor coverage years (contract term) | Parts coverage years |
|---|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | 2 | 0 (parts never paid) |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | 5 | 0 (parts never paid) |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | 10 | 0 (parts never paid) |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | 10 | 10 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | 12 | 12 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | 12 | 12 |

**Covered components.** A claim is covered only for a component listed against the tier. The lists build on one another:

- **Workmanship group** (all six tiers): installation workmanship; line set.
- **Major-component group** (every tier except the Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty): compressor; condenser coil; evaporator coil; heat exchanger; blower motor; condenser fan motor; inducer motor; control board.
- **Controls-and-valves group** (Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection, Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus): igniter; flame sensor; gas valve; pressure switch; capacitor; contactor; TXV metering device; reversing valve; defrost board.
- **Accessory group** (Harbison 12-Year Total Protection and Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus only): condensate pump; thermostat.

| Tier | Workmanship | Major components | Controls and valves | Accessories |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | covered | not covered | not covered | not covered |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | covered | covered | not covered | not covered |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | covered | covered | covered | not covered |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | covered | covered | covered | not covered |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | covered | covered | covered | covered |

**Terms common to every tier.**

- Parts are secondary to the manufacturer on all six tiers: a part is paid only once no manufacturer parts warranty applies.
- Repairs performed by another contractor are not reimbursed on any tier.

**Reading the schedule (hypothetical illustrations).**

- A gas valve failure on a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection contract names a component outside that tier's list; on a Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract the same component is listed.
- A thermostat appears only on the two 12-year tiers.
- A Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract and a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection contract list the same components and share a 10-year term; they differ in that the first pays no part at all while the second pays parts for up to 10 years once no manufacturer parts warranty applies.
